title: How a Self-Described ‘Junkie’ Rode Synthetic Drugs to Oblivion — and Fame
summary_full: An Estonian addict could barely keep pace with the new drugs flooding the market. His terrifying accounts of the cruel toll they took on his body held his country in its grip.
